WoW: Forever

Subtlety Rogue

Stealth openers and a RuptureRuptureSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost25 ManaRangeMeleeDuration10 secInflicts Physical damage to an enemy every 2 sec. for 10 sec.-driven bleed cycle. Icy Veins' lowest-rated Rogue spec overall, and it has no area damage of any kind.

WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated October 8, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70245 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Subtlety build has been tested. No source has published a level 30 build, so the level 30 line below extends the published level 20 one on the tree's own point costs.

What Subtlety is for

Mobility and stealth, bought early. CamouflageCamouflageTalentCastInstantReduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 15% and reduces its cooldown by 6 sec. sits in row 1 now, shortening the StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled. cooldown and raising move speed. Improved AmbushImproved AmbushTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 45%. strengthens the opener from row 2, within reach of an 11-point build. Ghostly StrikeGhostly StrikeTalentCastInstantCost40 ManaRangeMeleeCooldown20 sec cooldownDuration7 sec lands at exactly level 20 for 125% weapon damage, 180% with a dagger, plus 15% dodge for 7 seconds. It is non-positional: the one builder here that does not ask you to be behind the target.

Icy Veins rates it the lowest Rogue spec overall, 2.5 out of 5 Overall against 3.0 for the other two, while rating all three the same 4 out of 5 for levelling. Its heading is "Weakest Among Rogue Specs": "Subtlety gets the short end of the stick, with most of its higher-impact talents being unavailable until you can put more talent points into the tree." Wowhead agrees in stronger language, calling the spec "wholly underwhelming at this level bracket". It notes the Rogue lacks "our primary builder HemorrhageHemorrhageLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMeleeDuration15 sec" and the talents that support RuptureRuptureSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost25 ManaRangeMeleeDuration10 secInflicts Physical damage to an enemy every 2 sec. for 10 sec. this early.

The main problem is positional: "One of the biggest issues the spec has is its positional requirement… you won't be able to do so very often when leveling solo."

Blizzard's stated intent is two builds in this tree, one on Sinister StrikeSinister StrikeSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost45 ManaRangeMeleeInflicts normal damage plus 1 to an enemy. and one on BackstabBackstabSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9Cast3 sec castCost60 ManaRangeMeleeTeaches Backstab (Rank 9).: the new row 6 talents QuietusQuietusTalentCastInstantYour Sinister Strike, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities cause 10% more damage against targets below 35% health. and CutthroatCutthroatTalentCastInstantYour Backstab has a 15% chance to cause your next Ambush within 10 sec to not require Stealth. serve them in turn. Both are level 35, so neither helps while you level.

"solely for when you inevitably pull aggro." Once HemorrhageHemorrhageLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMeleeDuration15 sec is reachable: use it to build, then RuptureRuptureSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost25 ManaRangeMeleeDuration10 secInflicts Physical damage to an enemy every 2 sec. for 10 sec. immediately on long fights.

Multi-target: none. Wowhead: "No AoE capabilities whatsoever."

Stat priority

Weapon damage favouring a slow main hand, then Hit and Expertise, Agility, attack power, critical strike, Strength.

This spec's list differs from the other two. The published example shows why: "Between a 15 DPS weapon that has a 1.9 speed, and a 14 DPS weapon with a 2.8 speed, the 2.8 speed one will serve you better."

What Forever changed for Rogues

  • HemorrhageHemorrhageLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMeleeDuration15 sec is no longer a shared physical-damage debuff. It is a personal RuptureRuptureSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost25 ManaRangeMeleeDuration10 secInflicts Physical damage to an enemy every 2 sec. for 10 sec. amplifier now, and does nothing for the rest of your group. Do not take a raid assignment on it.
  • Improved AmbushImproved AmbushTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 45%. moved from row 3 to row 2, which is why an 11-point Subtlety build can reach it at all. Heightened SensesHeightened SensesTalentCastInstantIncreases your Stealth detection as if you were 3 levels higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 6%. moved up to row 4. Blizzard does not say SetupSetupTalentCastInstant moved, but Icy Veins' 11-point build takes it, which row 4 would not allow. SetupSetupTalentCastInstant and InitiativeInitiativeTalentCastInstantGives you a 100% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability. now both reach 100% at 3 points. SetupSetupTalentCastInstant only awards its combo point when the target you dodged or resisted a spell from is also your current target (October 1 build), and levelling solo is single-target anyway. Master of DeceptionMaster of DeceptionTalentCastInstantReduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were 3 levels higher. costs 3 points instead of 5 for the same effect.
  • Using SapSapLevel 10 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost65 ManaRangeMeleeDuration25 secIncapacitates the target for up to 25 sec. Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat. Any damage taken will break the effect. Only 1 target may be sapped at a time.   • Poisons and Lockpicking are secondary skills now, not class skills, and poison stacks with a sharpening stone. Rogues can learn axes, starting at skill 1.

At level 60

Unknown: whether the Thousand CutsThousand CutsTalentCastInstant and HemorrhageHemorrhageLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMeleeDuration15 sec bleed cycle works as a raid specialisation. Blizzard describes Thousand CutsThousand CutsTalentCastInstant as knocking 3 Energy off your next HemorrhageHemorrhageLevel 30 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMeleeDuration15 sec or BackstabBackstabSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9Cast3 sec castCost60 ManaRangeMeleeTeaches Backstab (Rank 9). per RuptureRuptureSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost25 ManaRangeMeleeDuration10 secInflicts Physical damage to an enemy every 2 sec. for 10 sec. tick, stacking five times. ClassicWoW.gg puts Thousand CutsThousand CutsTalentCastInstant at 31 Subtlety points minimum, since it requires PreparationPreparationTalentCastInstantCooldown600 sec cooldownWhen activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities., and MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantRangeMelee at 21 Assassination points. Together that is 52, one more than Forever's 51-point budget, so the two cannot coexist in one build.

Sources

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other. Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools.
